title: fix(console): the Studio object-reference picker offers objects by label, not machine name

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio「全部元数据」表单里选对象的下拉框(例如 新建页面 → Object)现在每一项先显示对象的标签(如「R5 Label Item」),后面跟一个小号等宽灰字的机器名(`r5lbl_item`),和流程触发器、Lookup 关联对象选择器的样子一致;没有标签的对象只显示一次名字。
- 为什么改:原来下拉里是 127 个裸机器名,作者要靠猜名字找对象,违反「标签优先于机器名」的界面约定。
- 风险与回滚:只改显示;保存的值仍然是机器名。标签取自页面本来就发的那一次对象列表请求,没有新增请求。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`widgets.tsx` 的 `RefObjectWidget` 选项渲染;`ResourceEditPage.tsx` 的 `objectsState` 加载器与 `widgetContext` 里新增的 `objectLabels` 一行;新测试 `RefObjectWidget.labels-33104.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/RefObjectWidget.labels-33104.test.tsx`,预期 3 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The page keeps each label from its one object-list read.** `MetadataResourceEditPage`'s `objectsState` loader already read `client.list('object')` but mapped each entry to its name and dropped the label. It now keeps `{ name, label? }` (a label is kept only when it is a non-blank string), sorted by name exactly as before. The widget context derives both members from that one state: `objectNames` through `mapLoaded` (unchanged shape, so `object-selector` and every other reader see what they saw), and a new `objectLabels` (`ReadonlyMap` name → label) while the list is loaded. No second list request.
- **`RefObjectWidget` draws the label first.** `WidgetContext` gains `objectLabels`, an optional read-only `Map` from object name to label (app-shell is private; the type is not published). Each option of the `ref:object` select shows the label, then the machine name as secondary text in the classes the Studio `ObjectPicker` uses for its option name (`font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground`), with an explicit space so the accessible name is two words. It stays on one line because Radix renders the selected item's text into the one-line trigger too. An object with no label is drawn as its name, once. The `SelectItem` value is the name, so the value written is unchanged.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/33104-ref-object-picker-labels.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch (app-shell is private and ships inside the console build).

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/RefObjectWidget.labels-33104.test.tsx` (new), driven through the opened Radix select (`ArrowDown` on the trigger, as the sibling suites do):

1. `SchemaForm` with the page type's real `createSchema` (Page → Object): the labelled object's option shows "R5 Label Item" first and `r5lbl_item` in the monospace muted name line; clicking it emits `object: 'r5lbl_item'` (the value written is the name).
2. CONTROL: a label-less object (`showcase_note`) is offered by its name only, with no name line, so the name is not shown twice.
3. `MetadataResourceEditPage` in Page create mode, with `client.list('object')` answering one labelled and one label-less entry: the picker shows the label the list answered, and `list('object')` was called exactly once.

**Measured on main first** (sources `widgets.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx` restored to `f068cde8`, test file as committed):

<details><summary>Base: 2 failed | 1 passed (3), the option text is the bare name</summary>

```text
× a labelled object: label primary, name secondary; choosing it writes the NAME
× the picker shows the label the list answered, and the list is read once
Expected element to have text content:
  R5 Label Item
Received:
  r5lbl_item
Test Files  1 failed (1) · Tests  2 failed | 1 passed (3) · VERDICT command-exit 1
```
The control (label-less object, name once) passes on base, as a control should. The base option in `RefObjectWidget` is a `SelectItem` whose value and whose text are both the bare name `n`, fed by the loader's `list.map((x) => x?.name)`.
</details>

**Ablation** of the label rendering only (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `widgets.tsx`, anchor `const label = context?.objectLabels?.get(n);` replaced by a branch that always yields `undefined` with marker `ABL33104`; anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `14bfddb9e5ec` → `bbcc0295e5bc`, run at `77376716`, before the one doc-comment commit; ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to `src/`, no dist in the path):

<details><summary>Ablated: 2 failed | 1 passed (3); restored: blob == HEAD, 3 passed</summary>

```text
× a labelled object: label primary, name secondary; choosing it writes the NAME
× the picker shows the label the list answered, and the list is read once
Expected element to have text content: R5 Label Item · Received: r5lbl_item
Test Files  1 failed (1) · Tests  2 failed | 1 passed (3) · VERDICT command-exit 1

```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Typeahead.** The select has no search box. Its keyboard typeahead is Radix Select's, which matches the typed prefix against one text per option (`item.textValue.toLowerCase().startsWith(...)` in `@radix-ui/react-select`), and that text now starts with the label. So typing a label's first letters jumps to the object, and typing a machine-name prefix reaches a labelled object only when its label starts the same way. Matching both label and name would need a searchable control instead of the Radix select; this PR does not swap the control. Declared, not pinned.
- **`object-selector`** (`ObjectSelectorWidget`, same file) still lists bare names. It reads the same `objectNames` and could read `objectLabels` the same way, but no form spec in this repository mounts `widget: 'object-selector'` (only its registry rows), so there is no measured reach. Noted, not filed.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on `ResourceEditPage.tsx` reports 3 `react-hooks` "Cannot create components during render" errors; the same 3 are on base `f068cde8` (line-shifted), none in the lines this PR touches.
